title: alert_rule and alert_rule_version columns must be migrated in lockstep
answers: Why does the alert rule version history show a different/truncated value than the live rule?
Do I need to migrate alert_rule_version too when changing an alert_rule column?
Alert rule versioning keeps stale or wrong column type
body:
Invariant: alert_rule and alert_rule_version tables carry duplicate columns (e.g. missing_series_evals_to_resolve) that must be kept in sync in both schema and data, since every rule update writes a new version row via the versioning mechanism.
Enforced at: pkg/services/ngalert/store/alert_rule_test.go TestIntegrationUpdateAlertRules asserts both the current alert_rule row and the corresponding alertRuleVersion row carry the same value after an update.
What breaks if skipped: migrating/widening only one of the two tables' columns causes data loss or truncation in the version history even though the live rule is correct, or vice versa.
Fix pattern seen here: any migration touching an alert_rule column must add a matching migration for the same column on alert_rule_version.
applies: Any schema change to pkg/services/ngalert alert_rule table
